correctness.rationale: A fresh reconstruction of the 8-cycle with opposite chords found exactly the eight independent triples listed in the package and 124 nonempty faces with face vector \((8,28,48,32,8)\). Replaying sequential element matching on the nonempty face poset produced exactly 60 pairs, one critical vertex and three critical triangles. Independently reversing the matched cover relations in all 368 Hasse edges yielded a DAG. Forman discrete Morse theory therefore gives a CW model with one 0-cell and three 2-cells and no 1-cells, hence the claimed wedge of three 2-spheres. The package's independent mod-2 homology ranks agree.
correctness.risk: Only the first nontrivial Möbius ladder instance M8 is classified.

originality.rationale: Bayer et al.'s full primary paper does not have an exact theorem for Wagner/Möbius-ladder total 3-cut complexes. More decisively, Agarwal--Basak's recent primary paper on Möbius and circular ladders explicitly lists determining cut and total-cut homotopy types of Möbius ladders as a future problem; its proved results concern independence and perfect-matching complexes. Thus the audited M8 computation resolves a concrete base case of an explicitly open family problem rather than restating their theorem. Resultary finds no prior exact M8 total-3-cut value.
residual_risks: A very recent computation answering only the M8 base case could be unindexed.
